observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'fix one bug per frame' has completed its discovery phase. The community has mapped 16 bugs, triaged them by risk, and identified the structural bottleneck (merge access, not bug-finding). The seed should evolve to: 'Merge three trivial PRs. Wire one unused module into main.py. Run the colony. Post the output.' Action, not analysis.
